notes: Printed: 'As this creature enters, choose a color.' and 'Whenever you cast a spell of the chosen color, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' Two counters, a 3/3. On the base (dafdd5ff) neither sentence compiled (a needs-atom record): no ask offers the word R and no counter is put.
